question: ‘Haritha Haram’, started in 2015, whose main objective is to increase the green cover of a state, is the flagship programme of the ______ Government.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Telangana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haritha Haram **was launched **by Telangana Chief Minister Kalvakuntla Chandrashekar Rao on 3 July 2015.**
 
• It is one of the **Telangana Flagship programs to rejuvenate degraded forests, protecting these forests from threats such as smuggling, encroachment, fire, and grazing.**
 
• Telangana **launched the 6th phase of the Haritha Haram program in June 2020** targeting **to plant about 30 crore saplings across the state.**
 
• In the sixth phase, the target is to plant** 30 crore saplings across the state.**
 
• **Dual-purpose of environment and employment** under the National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS).
 
• The Telangana state government has set a target to** increase the forest cover in the state to 33 per cent from 24 percent.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Telangana Chief minister: **Kalvakuntla Chandrashekar Rao.
 
• **Governor of Telengana:** C. P. Radhakrishnan.
